name: Jochu Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Jochu Technology Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells optoelectronic components, molds, metal furniture, and medical devices in Taiwan and the rest of Asia. The company offers metal bezels and metal back covers. It also undertakes metal works of household furniture; and provides assistive devices of movement for elderly and disabilities, exoskeletons for heavy workload personnel, and household health care products. In addition, the company offers biomedical sensors; and integrated design services for healthcare systems. Further, it provides trading services.
